claim: Original low-poly fossil specimen study of AMNH 20135; not exact replica or calibrated scientific mesh
anatomical_coordinates: Design coordinates are (rostral a, dorsal-view-right r, dorsal z). With rostrum up, r is screen-right. This is a design tuple, not a right-handed anatomical XYZ basis.
coordinate_transform: Design (a,r,z) -> Blender (-r,-a,z); glTF (-r,z,a); mesh winding is recalculated, no negative object transform.
preserved_arch: dorsal drawing viewer-right when rostrum points up; Blender -X
missing_arch: dorsal drawing viewer-left when rostrum points up; Blender +X
